title: Indian Standard Specification / Test Method (IS IS_10524)
clause_1_scope: This Indian Standard (IS IS_10524) covers Indian Standard Specification / Test Method (IS IS_10524). This Indian Standard, which is identical with ISO 3983-1977 'Cereals and cereal products — Determination of alpha-amylase activity — Colorimetric method ' issued by the International Organisation for Standardization ( ISO), was adopted by the Indian Standards Institution on the recommendation of the Foodgrains and Foodgrain Industries Sectional Committee and approved by the Agricultural and Food Products Division Council. In the adopted standard certain terminology and conventions are not identical with those used in Indian Standards, attention is especially drawn to the following: a) Comma ( , ) has been used as a decimal marker, while in Indian Standards the current practice is to use point ( . ) as the decimal marker; b) Wherever the words ' International Standard ' appear, referring to this standard, they should be read as ' Indian Standard' ; and c) Wherever cross references appear in the text, only the corresponding Indian Standards shall be followed. marking_requirements: Each container, package or piece shall be marked indelibly with the manufacturer's name, brand/trademark, grade, batch number, and month/year of manufacture.
The product may also be marked with the Standard Mark (BIS Certification Mark) governed by the Bureau of Indian Standards Act.
